author: B

components.title: Compute monthly interest rate
components.what: Convert the nominal 5.9% APR compounded monthly to the monthly rate r = 0.059/12.

components.title: Determine number of payments
components.what: Calculate the total number of monthly payments: n = 6 × 12 = 72.

components.title: Apply amortization formula
components.what: Use PMT = P[r(1+r)^n]/[(1+r)^n−1], with P = 24000, r = 0.059/12, and n = 72, retaining full precision in intermediate calculations.

components.title: Round to nearest cent
components.what: Round the resulting monthly payment to two decimal places.

log.author: B
log.draft:
Monthly interest rate: r = 0.059 ÷ 12 = 0.0049166667.  
Number of payments: n = 6 × 12 = 72.

Using the standard amortization formula,
M = P[r(1+r)^n]/[(1+r)^n − 1]

M = 24000[0.0049166667(1.0049166667)^72]/[(1.0049166667)^72 − 1]  
≈ 396.6174, which rounds to $396.62.

FINAL: 396.62
